notes.claim: The numbers of an arrow are the amounts the basis arrows are scaled by, so the same arrow gets different numbers in a different basis.
Different coordinate systems are different ways of representing the same arrow.
Converting from a second grid to the first is matrix-vector multiplication by a matrix whose columns are the second grid's basis arrows.
For i2: the Clarke transform, used in three-phase work, is a change of basis that rewrites the three phase quantities as two components at right angles in a stationary frame.
